scope: Independent read-only P02 Session owner-status wiring review, before lifecycle finding repair; no phase acceptance
implementationReview: Bootstrap generates one real current invocation attempt identifier before inspection and retains it in both reused and started Session paths. Lock-owner arbitration metadata is distinct.
Session receipt time is assigned only after actual persistence/kernel observations; OwnerObservation does not replace the retained time with the current clock.

OwnerObservation copies the member slice while holding Session.mu, then releases that lock before mapping and local owner/profile reauthentication. This prevents the slice copy from aliasing mutable Session members.
The separately enrolled owner handle is required. Caller identity/scope come from actual local owner enrollment and OS checks in the adapter, not from request strings or role broker credentials.
Completed scoped cold health probe evidence is private and currently not passed into any ready mapping path. Warm retained records remain available with unknown write readiness.

blockingFindings.finding: The locked snapshot includes only Status, receipt time and attempt. It ignores retained cleanupFailure, actual Group child Exited/Done state and retiredGroup. A known-ended or cleanup-failed owned session can therefore still emit a successful started/degraded observation from a kernel snapshot within its three-second freshness interval.
blockingFindings.proofKind: Concrete source-path review; no new runtime reproduction claimed
blockingFindings.minimalCorrection: Include actual known owned lifecycle/cleanup observations under Session.mu and map them to fixed safe failed/non-ready status errors. Distinguish a reused session with no owned Group from an owned Group that exited or retired. Never refresh the receipt or expose PIDs, output, private paths or raw errors.

proposedFocusedChecks: Fresh real-owner Session snapshot with retained cleanupFailure must produce a safe failed/non-ready observation instead of successful started/reused.
An actual owned four-child Group with one child stopped must report known role exit even before Group.Done closes.
Actual whole-group stop or natural retirement must invalidate owned Session success; a genuine non-owned reused Session with nil Group must remain supported.
Concurrent Close, Group watcher and OwnerObservation race check must preserve coherent lifecycle/error state and retained receipt time.
Real current Bootstrap integration must bind actual generated invocation/time for both early and post-lock reuse plus cold start; private cold probe values alone must not become readiness.
